subject: QBR ops brief: roadmap firebreaks & timeline commitments
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR ops brief: roadmap firebreaks & timeline commitments

Team,

Attached is a first-pass QBR readiness matrix (QBR_Readiness_Matrix_v1.xlsx). The execs want a concise snapshot of: current roadmap status, launches within the next 60 days, and the top delivery risks with mitigations. I pulled the list of high-impact launches from the product board and highlighted three that are in the red lane for engineering capacity or external dependencies.

Immediate asks:
- By EOD Tue (2027-06-22): each owner to confirm go/no-go for their launch and list any blocking dependencies.
- Karthik: short note on build stability and infra constraints (2 bullets).
- Monica: updated timeline if any feature gating needs to move (one-line ask per feature).
- Irene: confirm any CS / customer-facing communications we should plan if timelines slip.

High-level framing (for the QBR slide):
- Goal: keep top-line launches that unlock revenue/retention on track; defer nice-to-have scope where it meaningfully lowers risk.
- Constraint: we have two infra maintenance windows in July; those are non-negotiable for Dedicated capacity.

Attachments: QBR_Readiness_Matrix_v1.xlsx (matrix + owner column) and a draft timeline graphic (launch_timeline_v2.png).

Thanks — please be succinct.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: QBR_Readiness_Matrix_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR ops brief: roadmap firebreaks & timeline commitments

Jonas —

Quick status from eng:
- Build stability: mainline CI flake rate rose ~12% last week after the runtime refactor; primary cause is a nondeterministic scheduler lock (PROD-1382). Mitigation: hotfix branch scheduled for Wed night; candidate build Thursday morning.
- Capacity: two GPUs in dedicated pool will be offline for maintenance Jul 6–7 (planned). This reduces burst capacity by ~18% and affects canary throughput for large-model tests. Mitigation: we can shift canary windows to off-peak hours and enable temporary soft-limits for non-production traffic.

I have updated the matrix with these items (owner=Karthik). If teams want to keep full scope, we need a formal approval to increase evening canary windows (ops tradeoff).

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
[Attachment: prod1382_hotfix_plan.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR ops brief: roadmap firebreaks & timeline commitments

Thanks Jonas. Quick product updates:

- Feature: "Dynamic Routing Policies" (customer-exposed routing control) — currently planned for 2027-07-15 canary. Blocker: dependency on the policy editor UI (UX scope is larger than expected). Proposal: ship backend routing as an API-only canary on 2027-07-08 and move full UI rollout to 2027-07-29. Tradeoff: smaller immediate revenue impact but reduces ship risk.
- Feature: "KV cache persistence" — on track but needs one extra week of integration testing due to added quantization permutations. New ETA: 2027-07-12 (was 2027-07-05).

Action request: if leadership prefers revenue-first cadence, we can prioritize the routing UI, but that will push KV cache persistence out further. Recommend decision to lock scope by Thu end-of-day so engineering can schedule canaries.

Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Product Strategy
[Inline: updated timeline rows added to QBR_Readiness_Matrix_v1.xlsx]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR ops brief: roadmap firebreaks & timeline commitments

Team —

Thanks for the quick updates. Short guidance from execs:

- Prioritize customer-facing revenue impact for this QBR. If backend-only canaries protect stability while UI is delayed, accept that tradeoff.
- Do not expand scope in the next two sprints; instead, reduce scope where it meaningfully reduces risk.
- Approve the hotfix plan for PROD-1382 and the temporary off-peak canary windows; Karthik to coordinate with infra ops.

Please treat Thu 09:00–09:30 PT as a hard sync (leadership standup) to lock scope and approve final timelines. Jonas, circulate the single-slide summary before the sync (one slide: launches, risks, decision ask).

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Nora Lee <nora.lee@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR ops brief: roadmap firebreaks & timeline commitments

All — thanks for the alignment. Final summary and action items (for the QBR slide and exec brief):

Decisions:
- Ship backend-only canary for Dynamic Routing Policies on 2027-07-08. Full UI rollout deferred to 2027-07-29. (Owner: Monica)
- KV cache persistence moved to 2027-07-12; additional integration week approved. (Owner: Monica + Eng)
- Hotfix for PROD-1382 approved; Karthik to run night patch Wed 2027-06-23 and candidate build Thu 2027-06-24. (Owner: Karthik)
- Off-peak canary windows approved for Jul maintenance (Owner: Karthik / Infra Ops)

Action items (owners / due):
- Jonas: circulate one-slide executive summary and updated matrix (Due: Thu 2027-06-24 17:30 PT) — DONE (attached updated matrix).
- Monica: update product board and communicate scope change to PMs + CS (Due: Fri 2027-06-25).
- Karthik: confirm hotfix outcome and post results to PROD-1382 (Due: Fri 2027-06-25).
- Irene: draft customer-facing note for Acme Health if the canary affects their scheduled tests (Due: Fri 2027-06-25).

Nora — looping you in so Acme has visibility; we do not expect customer-facing impact for your July tests but will confirm once the hotfix completes.

Attachments: QBR_Readiness_Matrix_v1.xlsx (finalized), launch_timeline_v2.png (updated).

Jonas
Jonas Weber
